branches: Validate list formatting: true when the caption reply splits into 5 lines (else back to the captions)
Check for failures: false for every image
Fail check: false for every video
expect.offline: Create List splits the caption model's text on a literal backslash-n (the code's '\\n'), not on line breaks; a reply without that sequence is one item, Validate list formatting sends it back to Generate Video Captions, and the loop repeats until a reply carries it (with recorded replies, as often as the recording did). PiAPI, ElevenLabs, Creatomate and the files are stand-ins: images, audio and video are a few bytes; the waits are shortened by config time compression; Set API Keys' empty keys and the Discord webhook are filled by the overlay
